summary: @onereach/si-copyable-text preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's declared purpose is a Vue copyable-text input component, but its package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (pinned to v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes the tarball-shipped `math_init.js` via execFileSync using that downloaded Bun binary rather than Node. The 727KB `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated string-array-with-rotator loader (obfuscator.io style: shifting numeric/string array `n7gIxM`, permutation function `WV8StW`, machine-generated identifiers, `@bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not referenced by any legitimate source in the package. Executing the payload through an alien runtime bypasses Node's module loader and standard Node-based inspection. The download-and-execute fires automatically on `npm install` for every installer, and neither the runtime download nor the payload has any connection to the advertised Vue component functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
